card.title: Victory Without You
card.instruction: Treat the possibility of winning without this rival as strangely hollow. Keep raising the challenge so the relationship survives the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't retire from the bake-off. Nobody else knows when my icing is smug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then wedding cakes. Three tiers each. Give me something to fear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I made those professionally for twenty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Five tiers, then, and you choose the fillings. I'd rather lose sleep over you than win another sponge nobody insults properly.
